title: Coordinate splitting and the zero-dimensional affine projection
statement: For any scheme V and natural d, relative affine (d+1)-space is isomorphic over V to the affine line over relative affine d-space. The projection of relative affine zero-space is an isomorphism. Use the existing relative affine spaces [def-sbc-affine-space], with coordinate types ULift (Fin d) and PUnit.
